summary: This is a YAML front-matter block for a blog post or documentation article, containing metadata like publication date, URL slug, title, and author information. The highlighted lines (8-11) mark which fields should be emphasized or specially processed by the documentation system.

explanations.3: The slug is a URL-friendly identifier for this post; instead of using the full title, Docusaurus will make the page accessible at something like /blog/docusaurus-relatedposts.
explanations.7: This indicates the post belongs to a series called 'Creating Docusaurus components', which might group related articles together on the site.
explanations.8: The # highlight-start and # highlight-end comments tell Docusaurus to visually emphasize or differently render the lines between them, usually in code examples or documentation displays.
explanations.9: mainTag designates 'docusaurus' as the primary category or theme for this post, probably used for filtering or organization purposes.
